heading: Where the extrusions end up
intro: The same billet becomes a curtain wall mullion, a desk leg or a battery tray, depending on the die it is pushed through, the finish it is given and the fabrication that follows. These are the jobs our profiles are drawn for.

items.title: Unitised curtain walling
items.text: Mullions and transoms in 6063-T6, thermally broken with polyamide strips and powder coated before the units are glazed.

items.title: Rainscreen cladding
items.text: Honeycomb panels bonded to 1 mm skins, cut to size and folded into cassettes for concealed-fix carrier systems.

items.title: Solar shading
items.text: Aerofoil and box louvres up to 4 m long, anodised to 20 microns for coastal sites where a powder coat would chalk.

items.title: Windows and doors
items.text: Casement, sliding and lift-and-slide frames, with the hardware channels and drainage slots machined before despatch.

items.title: Balustrades
items.text: Base channels and top rails for structural glass, supplied mill finish or in a wood grain to match the joinery beside them.

items.title: Partition systems
items.text: Slim double-glazed office partitions on 45 mm and 80 mm frames, in matt black anodise or a powder coat matched to the client's colour.

items.title: Ceiling and wall baffles
items.text: Open-cell grids and blade baffles, punched for services and clipped to carrier rails with no fixings on show.

items.title: Lighting profiles
items.text: Recessed, surface and suspended LED channels with their diffuser tracks, cut to length and end-capped.

items.title: Shower enclosures
items.text: Wall profiles, glass channels and seal carriers for walk-in screens. Anodised finishes hold up where the water is hard.

items.title: Skirting and trim
items.text: Shadow-gap skirting, corner beads and tile trims, in brushed or wood grain finishes.

items.title: Desk and table frames
items.text: Legs, beams and cable trays for height-adjustable desks, drilled and tapped so the fitter only needs a hex key.

items.title: Handleless kitchen profiles
items.text: J-profiles, C-channels and gola rails cut in matched lengths, so a run of doors reads as one continuous line.

items.title: Wardrobe and sliding tracks
items.text: Top-hung tracks, bottom guides and frame sections for sliding and folding door sets.

items.title: Shelving uprights
items.text: Slotted uprights and brackets for shop and library fit-outs, anodised so a repeat order still matches years later.

items.title: Seat frames
items.text: Bent and welded frames for contract chairs and benches, supplied ready for upholstery.

items.title: Bus and coach bodywork
items.text: Floor planks, window pillars and skirt sections, extruded to the bodybuilder's own dies and held in stock for them.

items.title: Truck bodies and trailers
items.text: Side boards, load-securing rails and tailgate sections in 6082-T6, where the weight saved is weight carried.

items.title: Battery enclosures
items.text: Tray extrusions and friction-stir-welded floors for electric vehicle packs, machined flat for the sealing face.

items.title: Car trim and roof rails
items.text: Bright-anodised mouldings, roof rails and sill covers for the vehicle accessories market.

items.title: Marine fittings
items.text: Rubbing strakes, deck sections and mast track, anodised for salt water and specified by alloy rather than by colour.

items.title: Machine framing
items.text: T-slot profiles from 20 mm to 80 mm, cut and tapped to a drawing and sent with the brackets and fasteners.

items.title: Heat sinks
items.text: Deep-fin extrusions for inverters and LED drivers, run on the large press and cut to length.

items.title: Solar mounting
items.text: Rails, mid and end clamps for roof and ground-mount arrays, mill finish or anodised for a twenty-five year life.

items.title: Conveyor and handling
items.text: Guide rails, side frames and roller supports for packaging and bottling lines.

items.title: Cable management
items.text: Ladder, tray and trunking sections for plant rooms and tunnels, where steel would have to be galvanised first.
